items.name: ui-base
items.title: UI Foundation Base
items.description: Base dependencies, utilities and neutral semantic theme for UI Foundation components.

theme.font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

items.docs: Neutral and Comfortable are the defaults. Set data-ui-density to compact, comfortable or spacious. Add theme-tis separately and set data-ui-theme="tis" on the document root to opt into the TIS identity.

items.name: theme-tis
items.title: TIS Theme
items.description: Optional standalone TIS identity preset for UI Foundation.
items.docs: Apply data-ui-theme="tis" to the html element. Add class="dark" on the same element for dark mode. This preset has no dependency on ds-tis.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that reveal content.

meta.accessibility: Base UI connects headings, triggers and panels; Enter and Space toggle a panel while Tab follows normal document order.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A static status message with optional title, icon and action.

meta.accessibility: Uses role=alert; reserve it for content that should be announced immediately.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal confirmation surface for important or destructive decisions.

meta.accessibility: Always provide a title and description; Base UI traps focus and requires an explicit response.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: A layout primitive that preserves a fixed width-to-height ratio.

meta.accessibility: The wrapper is presentational; provide appropriate semantics and alternative text for its content.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file attachment surface with media, metadata, actions and an optional trigger.

meta.accessibility: Use descriptive filenames, expose file type and size in text, and label icon-only actions.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A user or entity image with fallback, badge and grouping support.

meta.accessibility: Provide meaningful alt text for informative images and always include AvatarFallback.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact label for status, category or metadata.

meta.accessibility: Decorative badges must not be the only way status is communicated.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A hierarchical path that locates the current page within a structure.

meta.accessibility: Uses a named breadcrumb navigation landmark and aria-current on the current page.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A conversational content surface with alignment and reaction support.

meta.accessibility: Keep sender and timing information available in text and preserve chronological reading order.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A primary action primitive with visual variants and sizes.

meta.accessibility: Base UI preserves native button semantics, disabled state and keyboard activation.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: A visual and semantic grouping for closely related actions or controls.

meta.accessibility: Provide an accessible label for the group when the relationship is not clear from context.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A date selection calendar with single, multiple and range modes.

meta.accessibility: Provide a visible purpose and date format; React DayPicker manages the calendar grid and keyboard navigation.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A compositional surface for grouped content and actions.

meta.accessibility: Choose semantic children and headings based on the content hierarchy.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A keyboard-operable sequence of slides powered by Embla Carousel.

meta.accessibility: Name the carousel and every slide, provide Previous and Next as non-drag controls, and do not capture arrow keys from interactive slide content.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Token-aware wrappers, tooltip and legend utilities for Recharts visualizations.

meta.accessibility: Provide a textual summary or data table and never rely on color alone to distinguish series.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A binary or mixed-state selection control.

meta.accessibility: Pair with FieldLabel; Base UI manages checked, indeterminate and disabled states.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A trigger that reveals or hides a single region of related content.

meta.accessibility: Base UI connects the trigger and panel with expanded and controlled-region state while preserving trigger focus.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable single or multiple selection input with listbox behavior.

meta.accessibility: Use a visible label and name clear or remove actions; Base UI manages active options, selection, filtering and keyboard navigation.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable command list that can be embedded or opened in a dialog.

meta.accessibility: Name the search input, keep items inside groups with stable values, and attach one observable onSelect action to every executable command.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A contextual action menu opened from pointer or keyboard interaction.

meta.accessibility: Base UI manages focus and menu navigation; every action must remain available without a pointing device.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A reusable TanStack Table composition with sorting, filtering, pagination and selection support.

meta.accessibility: Requires an accessible table name, exposes aria-sort on sortable headers and keeps filter and pagination controls keyboard operable.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A controlled or uncontrolled date selection composition built from Button, Calendar and Popover.

meta.accessibility: Use a visible FieldLabel and named popup; the trigger restores focus, the calendar preserves DayPicker keyboard navigation and the hidden form value follows disabled state.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal task surface with focus management and dismissal behavior.

meta.accessibility: Always provide DialogTitle and DialogDescription; Base UI manages focus trapping and restoration.

items.name: direction
items.title: Direction
items.description: A provider for left-to-right and right-to-left component behavior.

meta.accessibility: Keep the provider direction aligned with the document language and reading order.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A swipeable edge panel with modal, nested and snap-point behavior.

meta.accessibility: Always provide a title, description and explicit close path; swipe and snap points require equivalent non-drag controls, and the base stylesheet positions body for iOS Safari.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: An anchored menu for actions, selections and nested commands.

meta.accessibility: Use menu items for actions rather than site navigation; Base UI manages roving focus and keyboard navigation.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A structured empty state with media, explanation and an optional next action.

meta.accessibility: Use a real heading and concise description; keep the primary recovery action keyboard accessible.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A semantic composition for labels, controls, descriptions and validation messages.

meta.accessibility: Connect labels, descriptions and errors to the control with stable IDs and aria-describedby.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: A native form composition with Field-based body layout, pending state and responsive actions.

meta.accessibility: Preserves native form submission and validation semantics; compose every control with a visible label and connected error text.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A non-modal preview surface shown from hover or keyboard focus.

meta.accessibility: Use a real destination link as the trigger, keep focus on that link and never hide essential information or actions only in the visual preview.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text input built on the Base UI input primitive.

meta.accessibility: Use inside Field with a visible label; provide autocomplete and inputMode where relevant.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: A text control composed with inline addons, actions or keyboard hints.

meta.accessibility: Use InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea with a visible external label and named icon buttons; clicking a non-interactive addon focuses the contained control.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A segmented one-time-password input backed by a single accessible value.

meta.accessibility: Provide a visible label, autocomplete=one-time-code and clear validation text.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A compositional row for media, title, description and related actions.

meta.accessibility: Use Field instead when the row contains a form control; label icon-only actions.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A compact representation of keyboard input or shortcuts.

meta.accessibility: Include the shortcut in adjacent text when its meaning is not evident from the key labels.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A visible label for form controls.

meta.accessibility: Use htmlFor to bind the label to a native or Base UI control.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A compact annotated line with optional icon, border or separators.

meta.accessibility: Mark decorative icons hidden and keep the marker text meaningful without visual separators.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A persistent horizontal set of menus for application commands.

meta.accessibility: Use for application commands, place items inside MenubarGroup and connect every action; Base UI manages roving trigger and menu focus.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A structured conversation message with content, metadata and actions.

meta.accessibility: Preserve chronological DOM order and include sender and status information in accessible text.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A conversation viewport with managed anchoring and scroll-to-start or end controls.

meta.accessibility: Announce newly received messages intentionally and keep scroll controls named and keyboard operable.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: A styled native select for simple options and platform-native behavior.

meta.accessibility: Associate the select with a visible label and use optgroup for meaningful option groups.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: A responsive navigation structure with links and optional disclosure panels.

meta.accessibility: Name the navigation landmark, use real links, mark the current route and keep disclosed destinations reachable by keyboard.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A page navigation pattern with current, previous, next and overflow states.

meta.accessibility: Provide unique native links, mark exactly one current page, localize the landmark and remove unavailable Previous or Next links from the tab order.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A non-modal anchored surface for compact interactive content.

meta.accessibility: Use a meaningful trigger and title or description when the content needs a named region.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A determinate progress indicator with optional label and value.

meta.accessibility: Provide a label and meaningful value; use Spinner instead when progress is indeterminate.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A multi-step question flow with navigation and progress state.

meta.accessibility: The declared @shadcn/react flow owns step behavior; use semantic field groups and announce step changes, validation errors and progress.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A mutually exclusive set of options.

meta.accessibility: Wrap the group in FieldSet and FieldLegend; Base UI manages arrow-key navigation.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: A set of panels whose dimensions can be adjusted with a separator.

meta.accessibility: Keep the separator keyboard operable and provide sensible minimum and maximum panel sizes.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A styled scroll viewport that preserves native scrolling behavior.

meta.accessibility: Only add a tab stop when the region needs keyboard focus and provide an accessible name in that case.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A single-selection popup control with groups and scrolling support.

meta.accessibility: Base UI manages trigger, popup, active option and keyboard navigation relationships.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A horizontal or vertical visual divider.

meta.accessibility: Use decorative=false only when the divider conveys document structure.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A modal panel that enters from an edge of the viewport.

meta.accessibility: Always provide SheetTitle, SheetDescription and an explicit close path; content and actions must remain scroll-reachable at mobile widths and zoom.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A responsive application sidebar with collapsible and mobile sheet behavior.

meta.accessibility: Compose a named navigation landmark with real links, aria-current and the generated trigger relationship; keep a visible close path in the mobile Sheet.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A non-interactive placeholder for content that is loading.

meta.accessibility: Mark the containing region busy and provide a meaningful loading label outside the skeleton.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A single or range value input along a horizontal or vertical track.

meta.accessibility: Provide an accessible label and meaningful minimum, maximum and step values for every thumb.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: A lightweight toast renderer that follows the active UI Foundation theme.

meta.accessibility: Choose polite or assertive announcements based on urgency and keep important actions available elsewhere.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A compact animated progress indicator for indeterminate work.

meta.accessibility: Provides role=status and a default accessible label that can be localized.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An immediate on or off setting control.

meta.accessibility: Pair with FieldLabel; Base UI exposes switch semantics and checked state.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table primitives for structured rows, headers, captions and summaries.

meta.accessibility: Use header cells with scope, a caption or nearby heading, and expose sorting state when interactive.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: A set of panels where one section is visible at a time.

meta.accessibility: Keep triggers inside TabsList; Base UI manages roles, selection and arrow-key navigation.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text input that grows with its content.

meta.accessibility: Use inside Field with a visible label and describe limits or requirements before errors occur.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A Base UI toast system with queueing, actions, swipe dismissal and a five-item visible limit.

meta.accessibility: Use the appropriate urgency, keep action labels concise and never rely on a transient toast for essential information.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state pressed control for formatting or view options.

meta.accessibility: Provide an accessible name, especially for icon-only toggles; Base UI exposes pressed state.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A single or multiple selection group composed from toggle items.

meta.accessibility: Provide a group and item names, unique array values and an explicit selection mode; visual orientation is forwarded to Base UI keyboard behavior.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short non-interactive explanation for a focused or hovered trigger.

meta.accessibility: Do not place interactive content in a tooltip; wrap the application in TooltipProvider.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: A token-aware Typeset container for semantic HTML and rendered Markdown content.

meta.accessibility: Preserves the semantics of headings, paragraphs, lists, links, code and tables; content authors remain responsible for a logical heading order.

items.name: dashboard-overview
items.title: Dashboard Overview
items.description: A responsive product dashboard with metrics, an accessible trend chart and recent activity.

meta.accessibility: Includes a labelled chart with an accessibility layer, a named activity table and a heading-led page hierarchy.

items.name: login-page
items.title: Login Page
items.description: A complete sign-in surface with native form semantics, password recovery and account access guidance.

meta.accessibility: Uses native labelled inputs, autocomplete attributes, a submit button and visible recovery links.

items.name: settings-page
items.title: Settings Page
items.description: A responsive workspace settings form for identity, localization and notification preferences.

meta.accessibility: Groups visible labels, descriptions and native form controls in a predictable keyboard order.

items.name: team-members
items.title: Team Members
items.description: A member management card with identity, role, status and explicit row actions.

meta.accessibility: Every member action has a unique accessible name and status remains available as text.

items.name: chart-recipes
items.title: Chart Recipes
items.description: Six token-aware and accessible Recharts recipes: Area, Bar, Line, Pie, Radar and Radial.

meta.accessibility: Every chart has an accessible name, Recharts accessibility layer and a concise text summary of the data.
